sentences.en: The art of pleasing is the art of deception.
sentences.zh: 取悦的艺术就是欺骗的艺术。

sentences.en: Deception was deeply rooted in the character of the mustachioed captain.
sentences.zh: 那浓眉大眼的船长身上深藏着欺骗的习性。

sentences.en: Jugurtha was betrayed with a crude act of deception.
sentences.zh: 朱古瑟塔被拙劣的欺骗行为背叛了。

senses.zh: 欺骗 - 骗术, 诡计
